device.name: HimLoco Unitree Go2 velocity (Isaac Lab simulation)

facts.text: Unitree-Go2-Velocity is registered with entry point himloco_lab.envs:HimlocoManagerBasedRLEnv and the training configuration velocity_env_cfg:RobotEnvCfg
The environment's step returns six values: observations after reset, observations before reset, rewards, terminated flags, timeout flags and extras
The Go2 asset lists 12 joints: hip, thigh and calf for each of the four legs
The joint-position action applies scale 0.25 with the default joint offset and clips the processed action to -100 to 100
The velocity command is an SE(2) command: linear velocity in x and y plus angular velocity around z
The policy observation group has velocity commands, base angular velocity, projected gravity, relative joint positions, relative joint velocities and the last action
Every policy observation term is clipped to -100 to 100
The environment advances 4 physics steps of 0.005 s per environment step and an episode lasts 20 s
The upstream licence metadata is inconsistent: the setup.py SPDX header says BSD-3-Clause while the setup() call declares Apache-2.0

determinism.notes: reset(seed) reseeds the fake's command draw, so one seed repeats the initial policy observation; the fake does not model the upstream's numpy/torch random streams or its domain randomisation

gaps: the fake is a contract stand-in, not the Isaac Lab simulator: it does not integrate the Go2 rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuators, sensors, terrain or domain randomisation; the reward is always 0

the fake exposes the policy observation group only (45 values); the upstream environment also has a critic group with base linear velocity, external force and a height scan whose sensor dimension is not visible in the clone
the upstream step returns six values (observation, pre-reset observation, reward, terminated, timeout, extras); the fake returns the five-value Gymnasium form the bridge accepts
the fake's action space uses the configured joint-position clip (-100, 100) as its bounds; the raw action space of the Isaac Lab environment is provided by Isaac Lab and was not observed here
gymnasium, torch, Isaac Lab and Isaac Sim are not installed where the gate runs; the sim backend (gymnasium.make('Unitree-Go2-Velocity')) was not run and needs a GPU
no rendering, no video recording and no exact state snapshot/restore are offered

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop no step or reset is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the last observation stays readable
